say:1:1422636001:1.text: Here, the world feels quiet and warm, bathed in sunlight and scattered with flowers. The clatter of workshops and the marks of industry seem far away.
say:1:1422636001:1.source_cn: ……这里，如此静谧而舒适，到处都是花草与阳光，看不到多...

say:2:1422636002:1.text: This place brims with natural life... it's nothing like Brimstone Village or Sal'thorin.
say:2:1422636002:1.source_cn: 这里充满着自然的生机……既不像深岩村，又和萨洛克兰完全不同。

say:3:1422636003:1.text: The residents wear peaceful smiles as if they are one with the very nature around them.
say:3:1422636003:1.source_cn: 居民们的脸上挂着平和的微笑，他们像是自然的一部分。

say:4:1422636004:1.text: Are they truly the same as us, the Essail of the past? It's hard to believe we were once a people who lived in such harmony with nature…
say:4:1422636004:1.source_cn: 这里的人们，就是我们艾塞勒千年前的同族吗？难以想象，我...

choice_prompt:5:1422636004.text: Are they truly the same as us, the Essail of the past? It's hard to believe we were once a people who lived in such harmony with nature…
choice_prompt:5:1422636004.source_cn: 这里的人们，就是我们艾塞勒千年前的同族吗？难以想象，我们曾经也是与自然共生的民族……

say:6:1422636005:1.text: It feels as though I'm looking at another version of myself... a self that had never been cast into the depths below.
say:6:1422636005:1.source_cn: ……像是看到了另一个可能的自己，一个没有被驱逐到幽暗地...

say:8:1422636006:1.text: Don't lose heart, Indris. We're here to find a way to lift the curse. Once we succeed, you and all the Essail can be like them.
say:8:1422636006:1.source_cn: 因度厄，别丧气。我们就是来想办法解除诅咒的，一旦成功，...

say:9:1422636007:1.text: Hammie is right! But Chippy also thinks that Sal'thorin is super special!
say:9:1422636007:1.source_cn: 漫漫说得对！而且，满满觉得萨洛克兰也很特别！
